name: Hawaii
note: Rainbow "Aloha State" plate.

name: Idaho
note: Keegan has no general-issue row (its "FAMOUS POTATOES" row is the baked-potato specialty plate). General issue is the red-white-blue scenic "Famous Potatoes" plate. CHANGES: retro black/white and white/teal "World Famous Potatoes" options from 2025 (HB 207), and ITD announced a new standard white-and-black plate available July 1, 2026.

name: Illinois
note: Lincoln / Chicago skyline "Land of Lincoln" design (2017); image is a vanity sample of the same base.

name: Indiana
note: Keegan image is a placeholder, as is the image on the BMV design page (https://www.in.gov/bmv/images/plate-placeholder.jpg). Current Indiana standard design not verified; the no-fee "In God We Trust" row (standplate_igwt-large.jpg) is the common alternative.

name: Iowa
note: Iowa skyline/county design (2017 base); current.

name: Kansas
note: CHANGED: Keegan image is the previous "Ad Astra" seal design. The new "To the Stars" standard (Statehouse dome in a state outline, blue-white-yellow gradient), chosen by public vote in Dec 2023, has been issued since Aug 19, 2024.

name: Kentucky
note: Default standard design. "Team Kentucky" (Oct 2022) is an optional alternate standard design, and both come with or without "In God We Trust".

name: Louisiana
note: No standard row; the personalized row shows the general-issue "Sportsman's Paradise" base.

name: Maine
note: CHANGED: Keegan image is the Chickadee plate (1999-2025). The new Pine Tree standard (pine tree and North Star, plus a plain "No Tree" option) has been issued since May 1, 2025, and Chickadee plates were replaced at renewal through Apr 2026.

name: Maryland
note: No standard row found in Keegan (989 MD rows are mostly organizational). General issue is the white plate with Maryland flag graphic (2016 base). Design described from general knowledge, not re-verified this session.

name: Massachusetts
note: Red-text "The Spirit of America" plate; current.

name: Michigan
note: Blue-on-white "Pure Michigan" standard (image file named Standard_PureMichigan). Keegan "Water-Winter Wonderland" is a no-extra-fee optional standard design.

name: Minnesota
note: No standard row; the personalized row shows the general-issue "Explore Minnesota / 10,000 lakes" base.

name: Mississippi

name: Missouri

name: Montana
note: No standard row in Keegan (mostly sponsor plates). General issue is the blue mountain "Montana" base. Serial format changed in 2025; no new design found.
